description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 256: (T1) 1x Oak - Crown Reduce back to previous reduction points by up to 1.5m, crown thin by 15%, (T2) 1x Multi stemmed Oak - Re-reduce back to previous reduction points by up to 2m, crown thin by 15%, (T3) 1x Hawthorn - Remove Ivy and dead wood, reduce in height by up to 1.5m, (T4) 1x Oak - Re-reduce back to previous reduction points by up to 2m, crown thin by 15%.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out as closely as possible in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
